goal: Implement flagzen-openfeature module providing FlagProvider adapter that delegates to the OpenFeature SDK with reason-based absence detection, native typed resolution, and evaluation context mapping

phases.name: Walking Skeleton
phases.description: Thinnest E2E slice: Gradle module, OpenFeatureFlagProvider implementing FlagProvider, delegation to OpenFeature Client, reason-based absence detection, ServiceLoader registration. Proves the adapter resolves a string flag and a boolean flag through OpenFeature end-to-end.

steps.name: String flag resolved through OpenFeature adapter
steps.description: Set up the flagzen-openfeature Gradle submodule, add it to settings.gradle.kts, wire the acceptance test dependency and OpenFeature SDK dependency. Implement OpenFeatureFlagProvider with Client constructor injection, getString() delegating to Client.getStringDetails() with reason-based absence detection. Create ServiceLoader registration. Update step definitions to match walking-skeleton feature file wording and implement the string flag setup/resolve/assert steps using InMemoryProvider as the test double.
criteria: settings.gradle.kts includes flagzen-openfeature
flagzen-openfeature/build.gradle.kts exists with api dependency on flagzen-core and implementation dependency on dev.openfeature:sdk
flagzen-acceptance-tests/build.gradle.kts includes flagzen-openfeature as testImplementation dependency
OpenFeatureFlagProvider implements FlagProvider and accepts a Client via create(Client) factory method
getString(key) delegates to Client.getStringDetails(key, "") and returns Optional.empty() when reason is DEFAULT or errorCode is non-null
getString(key) returns Optional.of(value) for any other reason (TARGETING_MATCH, STATIC, SPLIT, etc.)
META-INF/services/com.flagzen.spi.FlagProvider contains com.flagzen.openfeature.OpenFeatureFlagProvider
Step definitions updated to match walking-skeleton.feature wording (resolves/returns vs looks up/value is)
InMemoryProvider used as test double for upstream flag management service
Scenario 'Developer resolves a string flag through the OpenFeature adapter' passes
steps.scenario_name: Developer resolves a string flag through the OpenFeature adapter

steps.name: Boolean flag resolved through OpenFeature adapter
steps.description: Add getBoolean(key) to OpenFeatureFlagProvider delegating to Client.getBooleanDetails(key, false) with the same reason-based absence detection. Implement the boolean flag setup and assertion steps.
criteria: getBoolean(key) delegates to Client.getBooleanDetails(key, false) and applies reason-based absence detection
getBoolean(key) returns Optional.of(true/false) for valid resolutions
Step definitions for boolean flag setup and assertion implemented
Scenario 'Developer resolves a boolean flag through the OpenFeature adapter' passes
steps.scenario_name: Developer resolves a boolean flag through the OpenFeature adapter

phases.name: String Resolution
phases.description: Complete string resolution: named client construction, absent flag detection (no flag configured, evaluation error, no provider registered). Exercises all error and edge paths for getString().

steps.name: Adapter with named client resolves flags through that client
steps.description: Implement create(Client) factory wiring for a named/dedicated OpenFeature client. Implement step definitions for dedicated client setup and adapter construction with that specific client.
criteria: OpenFeatureFlagProvider.create(client) accepts any Client instance including named clients
Step definitions for dedicated client setup and named-client adapter construction implemented
Scenario 'Adapter constructed with a specific named client resolves flags through that client' passes
steps.scenario_name: Adapter constructed with a specific named client resolves flags through that client

steps.name: Flag not configured returns no value
steps.description: Verify that when the upstream InMemoryProvider has no flag for the given key, the reason-based detection returns Optional.empty(). Implement the 'has no flag named' Given step.
criteria: getString returns Optional.empty() when OpenFeature returns reason DEFAULT for an unconfigured flag
Scenario 'Flag not configured in the upstream service returns no value' passes
steps.scenario_name: Flag not configured in the upstream service returns no value

steps.name: Flag evaluation error returns no value
steps.description: Verify that when the upstream service returns an error (errorCode non-null), the adapter returns Optional.empty(). Implement the error-triggering Given step.
criteria: getString returns Optional.empty() when FlagEvaluationDetails has a non-null errorCode
Scenario 'Flag evaluation error in the upstream service returns no value' passes
steps.scenario_name: Flag evaluation error in the upstream service returns no value

steps.name: No upstream service configured returns no value
steps.description: Verify that when no OpenFeature provider is registered, the no-arg constructor adapter returns Optional.empty(). Implement the no-arg constructor path and the 'no flag management service' Given step.
criteria: No-arg constructor calls OpenFeatureAPI.getInstance().getClient() to obtain the global client
getString returns Optional.empty() when no provider is registered (NoOpProvider returns reason DEFAULT)
Scenario 'Adapter with no upstream service configured returns no value' passes
steps.scenario_name: Adapter with no upstream service configured returns no value

phases.name: Typed Resolution
phases.description: Native typed resolution for integer, double, and long flags via OpenFeature's typed detail methods. Long uses integer widening. Error and absent paths for typed flags.

steps.name: Integer flag resolved natively
steps.description: Add getInt(key) delegating to Client.getIntegerDetails(key, 0) with reason-based absence detection. Implement integer flag setup step.
criteria: getInt(key) delegates to Client.getIntegerDetails(key, 0) and applies reason-based absence detection
getInt(key) returns OptionalInt.of(value) for valid resolutions
Scenario 'Integer flag resolved natively' passes

steps.name: Double flag resolved natively
steps.description: Add getDouble(key) delegating to Client.getDoubleDetails(key, 0.0) with reason-based absence detection. Implement double flag setup step.
criteria: getDouble(key) delegates to Client.getDoubleDetails(key, 0.0) and applies reason-based absence detection
getDouble(key) returns OptionalDouble.of(value) for valid resolutions
Scenario 'Double flag resolved natively' passes

steps.name: Long flag resolved via integer widening
steps.description: Add getLong(key) delegating to Client.getIntegerDetails(key, 0) with widening cast from Integer to long. Implement long flag resolve/assert steps.
criteria: getLong(key) delegates to Client.getIntegerDetails(key, 0) and widens the Integer result to long
getLong(key) returns OptionalLong.of(value) for valid resolutions
Scenario 'Long flag resolved via integer widening' passes
steps.scenario_name: Long flag resolved via integer widening

steps.name: Typed flag evaluation error returns no value
steps.description: Verify that errorCode non-null on a typed (boolean) evaluation returns Optional.empty(). Implement the boolean error Given step.
criteria: getBoolean returns Optional.empty() when FlagEvaluationDetails has a non-null errorCode
Scenario 'Typed flag evaluation error returns no value' passes
steps.scenario_name: Typed flag evaluation error returns no value

steps.name: Absent typed flag returns no value
steps.description: Verify that an unconfigured typed flag (integer) returns empty via reason-based detection.
criteria: getInt returns OptionalInt.empty() when OpenFeature returns reason DEFAULT for an unconfigured flag
Scenario 'Absent typed flag returns no value' passes
steps.scenario_name: Absent typed flag returns no value

phases.name: Context Mapping
phases.description: EvaluationContext mapping from FlagZen to OpenFeature SDK. Targeting key, string/numeric/boolean attributes, absent targeting key, unsupported attribute type handling, context-aware typed resolution, and empty context passthrough.

steps.name: Flag resolved with targeting key and string attribute
steps.description: Implement EvaluationContextMapper that converts FlagZen EvaluationContext to OpenFeature EvaluationContext. Add getString(key, context) and all context-aware overrides to OpenFeatureFlagProvider that map the context and pass it to the Client's detail methods. Implement the targeting-key-based Given step for InMemoryProvider.
criteria: EvaluationContextMapper converts FlagZen targeting key to OpenFeature targeting key
EvaluationContextMapper converts string attributes to OpenFeature context attributes
getString(key, context) delegates to Client.getStringDetails with mapped OpenFeature EvaluationContext
Scenario 'Flag resolved with targeting key and string attribute' passes
steps.scenario_name: Flag resolved with targeting key and string attribute

steps.name: Flag resolved with numeric and boolean attributes
steps.description: Extend EvaluationContextMapper to handle integer and boolean attribute types. Implement the attribute-based targeting Given step.
criteria: EvaluationContextMapper converts integer attributes to OpenFeature integer attributes
EvaluationContextMapper converts boolean attributes to OpenFeature boolean attributes
Scenario 'Flag resolved with numeric and boolean attributes' passes
steps.scenario_name: Flag resolved with numeric and boolean attributes

steps.name: Flag resolved without a targeting key
steps.description: Verify that a FlagZen context with no targeting key produces an OpenFeature context with no targeting key. Implement the string-attribute-only targeting Given step.
criteria: EvaluationContextMapper omits targeting key from OpenFeature context when FlagZen context has none
Scenario 'Flag resolved without a targeting key' passes
steps.scenario_name: Flag resolved without a targeting key

steps.name: Unsupported attribute type skipped with warning
steps.description: Verify that unsupported attribute types (e.g., Instant) are skipped during context mapping and a JUL warning is logged. Implement log capture in the step definition.
criteria: EvaluationContextMapper skips attributes with unsupported types (not String, Integer, Long, Double, Boolean)
A java.util.logging WARNING is emitted naming the unsupported attribute type
Flag resolution still succeeds (unsupported attribute does not cause failure)
Scenario 'Unsupported attribute type is skipped during context mapping' passes
steps.scenario_name: Unsupported attribute type is skipped during context mapping

steps.name: Context-aware typed resolution and empty context
steps.description: Verify that context-aware typed methods (getBoolean with context) pass the mapped context through, and that an empty evaluation context does not disrupt resolution.
criteria: getBoolean(key, context) delegates to Client.getBooleanDetails with mapped OpenFeature EvaluationContext
Empty FlagZen EvaluationContext maps to an empty OpenFeature EvaluationContext without errors
Scenario 'Context-aware typed resolution passes context through' passes
Scenario 'Empty evaluation context does not disrupt flag resolution' passes
steps.scenario_name: Context-aware typed resolution passes context through
